I replied in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on **November 3, 2025**.

That date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025. It said ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own Dec 8, 2025 cutover recap gives the same official date.

The recap also says she kept running the account day to day through Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on **November 22**. I told her to use Nov 3 in the coverage tracker, and Nov 22 only if the tracker records the operational takeover.
